title: Exhaust muffler transmission loss
line: Transmission loss of a two-chamber exhaust muffler from 50 Hz to 2 kHz, against at least 15 dB in the 500 Hz band.
description: A two-chamber muffler in 1.5 mm aluminized steel: a 50 mm inlet pipe, a 180 mm bore shell split by a baffle into two 170 mm chambers tuned to a quarter wave at 500 Hz, and a 50 mm tail pipe. The gas inside is its own body in the RunMat MCAD part. The study sweeps one-third-octave bands from 50 Hz to 2 kHz and reports the transmission loss against at least 15 dB at 500 Hz.
thumbnailAlt: Transmission loss of a two-chamber exhaust muffler across one-third-octave bands, solved in RunMat
